summary: Two 15-year-olds seriously injured in a UTV rollover 300-450 ft down a steep slope in the Cement Creek drainage; Blackhawk hoist helicopter lifted both, then two CareFlight helicopters flew them to St. Mary's in Grand Junction
location: Cement Creek drainage near Italian/American Flag mountains
responding_agency: Crested Butte Mountain Rescue + Mt. Crested Butte Police, CB Fire, Gunnison Valley Health Paramedics, CSRA, HAATS, Vail Mountain Rescue, CareFlight
notes: One severe but non-life-threatening; off mountain in ~4 hours
